environment: candidate checkout and the assembled pinned xverse-platform target; offline, Python 3.11+; declared library bounds only, no scientific protocol value, no process, registry, network or filesystem mutation.
expected: Each declared finite library bound is enforced over its complete frozen scope: a per-payload list, the total compiled-parameter count C_total and a declared core System/Component parameter list each yield XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED with plan is None and no side effect; a declared limitation count above max_limitations is likewise rejected; parameter counts exactly at each declared bound compile one resolved plan; and the resolved plan carries exactly one components[scope="system"] entry whose declaredParameters contains every declared System.spec.parameters[] entry once, with no System parameter duplicated into a component-instance entry.
intended_use: An experiment author declares core System and Component parameters and supplies declared per-payload parameter lists whose individual lengths are each within ExperimentLimits.max_parameters while their compiled total exceeds it, plus a declared limitation count above the bound, and expects the frozen bound behaviour; an integrator reads the resolved plan to locate every declared core parameter.
title: Declared finite library bounds and System core-parameter projection (resolves XDL1-RVW-001/002/003)
